**graph:** in a Cargo crate (a `Cargo.toml` at the root of a git work tree), the graph's Rust calls, references and imports now come from pixel-mvp's index by default: on a judged sample of this repository, wrong Rust edges held fall from 72 of 72 to 0, correct ones held rise from 29 to 35 of 38. A one-file update takes about 0.85 s instead of 0.22 s here. `PIXEL_GRAPH_SOURCE_RUST=v1` restores the previous resolver.
